description: This file defines an Android activity 'List1' that displays a list of strings using a ListView populated via an ArrayAdapter. It retrieves string data from 'Cheeses.sCheeseStrings' and enables text filtering in the list view.

classes.name: List1
classes.description: A simple ListActivity that displays a list of cheese names using an ArrayAdapter.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when the activity is created; sets up the list adapter and enables text filtering.
